title: Creating a REST operation generates its routing (provider: ~~ANY~~ to local; consumer: local to WADL_NODE through HTTPTARGET)
statement: PIA forces Generate Any-to-Local for a REST operation (PSSERVICESWRK.SAVE_PB, public service). A provider operation gets a GENERATED Y routing from ~~ANY~~ to the default local node; a consumer operation one from the local node to WADL_NODE, CONNGATEWAYID the local gateway, CONNID HTTPTARGET. The routing is dated 1900-01-01, described by message 158,2382, named ~GENERATED~ plus a random 10000000..109999999, carries its parameters and sub-definition, and the operation version gets a PSOPRGENRTGPARM PUBSRVCSYNC row naming it. RTDM +1 and SYS +1 on top of the operation's own counters. A consumer service with a token type also copies its credentials to the request parameter.

observations.observation: PIA created a REST provider GET operation and a REST consumer GET operation; each save also inserted a generated routing with its parameters, sub-definition and a PSOPRGENRTGPARM row: OPRM, OPRVM, RTDM, SRVM +1 each, SYS +4.
